data.name: Heart of Homunculus
data.detailed_description:
Story

Play as Adella, a homunculus girl who has lost her memory. Set out on an adventure in a new world forged from steam-powered technology and magic. Meet other races, hunt for legendary treasures, and battle formidable foes. Along the way, reclaim those precious moments and recover your Heart, uncover the truth of the world, and confront the source of every disaster. In the end—will you save the world, or destroy it? The choice is yours.

About This Game

1. Explore a richly crafted world where steam-powered technology intertwines with magic. Beyond the legendary journey of the homunculus girl, every race has its own history and stories waiting to be uncovered. Piece together hidden and long-forgotten fragments of truth, and unveil the world's deepest secrets.

2. Discover a wide array of interchangeable weapons scattered across the land. Each one boasts unique skills and properties—master them to break through any challenge and turn the tide in your favor.

3. Customize your abilities through a complex modular augmentation system designed for the homunculus. These modules enhance her bodily functions, unlocking diverse combat styles and new possibilities. Hunt down blueprints, craft your abilities and watch your build come to life.

4. Experiment with a whimsical alchemy system. Combine materials freely based on their descriptions and traits, toss them into the alchemy furnace, and—boom!—you might brew a powerful potion… or create a rare artifact. That's the wonder of alchemy!

data.short_description: Heart of Homunculus is a side-scrolling ARPG . You play as Adella, a homunculus girl who has lost her memory. Journey through new world to recoup those moments you cherish and recover your heart. Unveil the truth behind the catastrophe, face formidable enemies, and become the savior of the world.
